🎙️ Psychology, Actually with Dr Marianne Trent is a podcast about what’s really going on beneath the surface of our lives.

Through conversations with psychologists, professionals, and inspiring guests, we explore the psychology shaping our work, our relationships, and our inner worlds bringing together clinical insight with genuine human understanding.

This show was previously known as The Aspiring Psychologist Podcast, and while it continues to support aspiring and qualified psychologists, it has grown into something broader. Because psychology doesn’t just shape our careers, it influences how we parent, how we grieve, how we connect, and how we cope when life doesn’t go to plan.

Alongside expert interviews, Dr Marianne Trent shares reflective solo episodes - making sense of complex human experiences with compassion, curiosity, and clarity.

Featuring conversations with leading voices in psychology including Professor Paul Gilbert, Dr Lucy Johnstone, and Dr Martha Deiros Collado - the podcast brings together a range of perspectives on what it means to live, work, and think psychologically.
New episodes are released every Monday at 6am (UK time).

Whether you’re an aspiring psychologist, a qualified practitioner, or simply someone interested in understanding yourself and others more deeply, this podcast offers thoughtful conversations that stay with you.

shows.description:
Discover + Heal + Grow is a trauma therapy and depth psychology podcast from Taproot Therapy Collective, a trauma-focused therapy practice in Hoover, minutes from Birmingham, Alabama. Licensed trauma therapists talk honestly, and sometimes irreverently, about complex PTSD, the brain, the psyche, and the cultural forces that shape all of us.

The world has enough whispery wellness podcasts telling you to eat clean and breathe deeply. Some episodes feel like drinks with a group of therapists after work. Others feel like sitting in on a university seminar.

Hosted by Joel Blackstock, LICSW-S, Taproot's founder and clinical director, with Taproot's therapists.
Meet Joel: https://gettherapybirmingham.com/joel-blackstock-bio/
Meet our therapists: https://gettherapybirmingham.com/our-therapists/

WHAT WE COVER
We come at creativity, intuition, and trauma through depth psychology and brain-based medicine:
- Trauma neurobiology and new trauma therapies, including EMDR, Brainspotting, and Emotional Transformation Therapy
- Jungian psychology, archetypes, and the shadow in art, design, film, and mass media
- The neuroscience behind new age and Eastern medicine concepts
- Brain-based medicine, QEEG brain mapping, and neurofeedback
- The psychology of artists, true crime, and political movements
- How therapy gets portrayed in film and television
- Burnout in therapists, physicians, and other helping professionals
- Relationships, consciousness, and the messy parts of being human

Guests range from researchers and clinicians to people with no credentials who have something true to say. It's for trauma therapists, students, and anyone working through their own history who wants more than coping tips.

Taproot Therapy Collective is a group practice for severe and complex trauma, PTSD, anxiety, and depression, based in Hoover and serving greater Birmingham.
